result.rationale: Diff line at EventManager.ts:119 reads `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"` with no optional chaining, while it is destructured from `evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` (so undefined when empty/null). Old code used `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`. The same diff changes multiple handlers (confirm, payments, editLocation) to pass `[]` as destinationCalendar, making this path reachable whenever a Google Meet location is used with no destination calendar — a TypeError replacing the intended Cal Video fallback.
